text:
miriam: quick check — onboarding optic-13b-q4 to prod tomorrow. weights are at s3://redwood-models/optic/13b/v2/q4/part-* (confirmed by storage team). i ran a small local load and saw weird token counts from the tokenizer (extra leading BOS sometimes). can folks review cfg below and call out any risky knobs before i open the canary?

jon: I briefly validated the S3 path and checksum yesterday. +1 on the tokenizer quirk — that usually comes from mismatch between tokenizer config and model repo (vocab version mismatch). did you run `tokenizer.json` from the same tag as weights?

miriam: yes, used tag v2-2026-02-12. i diffed the tokenizer.json and it seems identical, but inference wrapper adds a leading <bos> when prompt starts with whitespace. small repro: `tokenizer.encode(" Hello") -> [1, 42, 99, ...]` vs `tokenizer.encode("Hello") -> [1, 42, 99...]` (same ids but counts off by one for some evals).

alex: that aligns with a downstream eval failing when prompt trimming is enabled. for serving config i suggest: set `continuous_batching.target_latency_ms` conservative for canary, lower `max_tokens_per_batch` until we confirm KV cache stability. also set `max_context_length` explicitly so runtime can pick proper kernels.

kai: +1. quick suggested config (canary):
```json
{
  "continuous_batching": {
    "enabled": true,
    "target_latency_ms": 120,
    "max_tokens_per_batch": 4096,
    "min_batch_size": 2
  },
  "kv_cache": {
    "prefix_caching": true,
    "ttl_seconds": 300,
    "max_entries": 10000
  },
  "model": {
    "max_context_length": 8192,
    "max_output_tokens": 1024
  }
}
```
Kai: i set target_latency a bit higher so the scheduler doesn't force huge batches on the canary. once stable we can push target_latency -> 60 and increase `max_tokens_per_batch`.

jon: Watch out for `prefix_caching: true` + `max_context_length: 8192` on GPU 80GB setups — memory pressure may spike when multiple long contexts hit cache. consider `kv_cache.max_entries` per-worker or an eviction policy. also, set `batch_queue_priority` to `fifo` for this model initially to avoid starved small requests.

miriam: good point. what's the recommended eviction policy? lru?

kai: LRU is safest. we have an `approx-lru` implementation in the runtime that is cheaper. config snippet: `kv_cache.eviction_policy: approx-lru` and `eviction_threshold_pct: 70`.

alex: related note — tokenizer issue might be from space-preserving normalization. if the model was trained with `add_prefix_space: true` but the serving tokenizer not set, we get off-by-one. set `tokenizer.add_prefix_space` in model config = true to match training. also add a tiny preprocessing check in the serving adaptor: `if text.startswith(' '): text = text.lstrip() and add_special_bos()` — this avoids branches in decoder path but preserves ids.

miriam: will update tokenizer flag in model manifest and add a small lint check to gating script. i'll also open a PR for config changes: canary 10% for 24h -> increase if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: [preflight] optic-13b-q4 preflight results: checks passed (weights accessible, format ok), but automated tokenizer-smoke test failed (off-by-one). See /preflight/1850123456/report.

jon: thanks deploy-bot. i can take the PR review today — ping me when it's up. for canary metrics watch: p50 latency, 99th percentile tail, GPU memory, kv cache hits. set alerts for p99 > 850ms or OOMs.

miriam: noted. i'll add alert thresholds to the rollout doc and attach the small repro for tokenizer.

alex: one more thing — set `continuous_batching.max_tokens_per_request` to 2048 on the canary so single huge requests don't block batch formation. we had a similar outage when a single 6k request ate the batch window.

kai: agree. also reduce `batch_scheduler.max_concurrent_batches` to 4 for the canary to prevent oversubscription.

miriam: summary action items: 1) i update model manifest to set `tokenizer.add_prefix_space=true` + add lint check (miriam) 2) PR with canary config (10% / 24h) using kai's json + alex tweaks (miriam -> ping jon for review) 3) set alerts for p99/ooms (jon) 4) deploy-bot preflight re-run after PR (deploy-bot) 5) monitor kv cache pressure and adjust eviction (kai)

jon: sounds good. i'll review ASAP. :thumbsup:

miriam: thanks all — i'll post the PR link here once it's up. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [deploy] preflight rerun scheduled after PR merge.
